lines.en: I skim the sand surface.

lines.zh: 身下的沙，被我推成一道脊。
lines.en: I push the sand into a ridge beneath me.
I cross a stretch of dry ground.

lines.zh: 风把我的影子吹得歪斜。
lines.en: The wind slants my shadow.
I head for more open ground.
Something's moving down there.

lines.zh: 我落在土丘上，压塌了一角。
lines.en: I land on a mound and crush a corner.
I circle and descend slowly.

lines.zh: 翅膀撑得开，风一托就上。
lines.en: My wings spread; the wind lifts me.
I glide over that fissure.
I fly low, almost scraping the ground.

lines.zh: 我落下来，土被压出一圈。
lines.en: I land and the earth rings around me.

lines.zh: 我抬起前半身，看看四周。
lines.en: I raise my front half and look around.
I shift slowly to the other side.

lines.zh: 我的腹甲刮过石头，火星一样响。
lines.en: My belly plate scrapes stone, throwing sparks.

lines.zh: 我顺着沙脊滑下去，不费力。
lines.en: I slide down the sand ridge without effort.
I lie on the sand, wings folded.

lines.zh: 底下有东西在爬，我听得见。
lines.en: Something's crawling below. I can hear it.

lines.zh: 我这一代，已经长到头了。
lines.en: This is as far as my kind grows.
Beyond this, only new eggs.
There's fire in my throat, held back.
I open my wings slowly, then fold them.
I'm waiting for a moment.
My belly feels heavy.

lines.zh: 那些卵，终究要找个地方。
lines.en: Those eggs will need somewhere eventually.

lines.zh: 风把沙吹进我眼里，我不在意。
lines.en: Sand blows into my eyes. I don't care.

lines.zh: 我伏得更低，听地下的动静。
lines.en: I press lower and listen to the ground.
Footsteps. Up above.
You walk on the sand. Noisily.
I hear every step.

lines.zh: 我从空中喷火，之后就再也长不大。
lines.en: I breathe fire from above, never growing again.

lines.zh: 我不用靠近也能碰到你。
lines.en: I can reach you without coming closer.

lines.zh: 我从空中喷火，地上都焦。
lines.en: I breathe fire from the air and the ground scorches.
That interests me.
I raised my head. Did you see.
Breathing fire from the air is my job.
Half a step back is too late.
I'm only a few blocks away.

lines.zh: 我的翅破了一块，飞不稳。
lines.en: A tear in my wing. Flight is unsteady.
I flatten down against the sand.

lines.zh: 这一下，让我退了半格，翅膀还撑着。
lines.en: That pushed me back half a block; my wings still hold.
My shell cracked. No blood.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，喉咙还是热的。
lines.en: I raise my head. The throat's still hot.

lines.zh: 喉咙还是热的，我还能喷。
lines.en: My throat's still hot. I can still spray.
The soil caved beneath me.
I roll myself over, slowly.
Not enough.
I still have eggs to leave.
Spitting fire from the air is my trade.
I eat things that move.
If you put it down, will it still move?
If it doesn't move, I'm not interested.
You hold it high, and your hand shakes.
I can see that tremor clearly.
So small. Not enough.
I don't eat this. Keep it.

lines.zh: 你手里的肉，不合我胃口。
lines.en: The meat in your hand is not what I hunger for.
You're standing so close.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，像撞上一块石头。
lines.en: You hit me like a boulder.
I turn and the dirt turns up.
The sand collapses under me.

lines.zh: 你的靴底压住我的翅根。
lines.en: Your boot sole pins the base of my wing.
That, I don't like.

lines.zh: 我抬起前半身，把你顶开。
lines.en: I rear up and shove you off.

lines.zh: 我的翅鞘撞上你，沙土四散。
lines.en: My wing case hits you, scattering sand.
Get back. Don't stand under my belly.
That's the worst place to be.
I turn about, slowly.
In this stage I do one thing.
That's not what I'm here for.
This task is egg-laying.
A pit must be dug in the sand.
I've found the place.
Right below here.

lines.zh: 我的尾针，不是给你碰的。
lines.en: My tail sting is not for you to touch.
This ground is about to turn.

lines.zh: 新的东西会从土里出来。
lines.en: Something new will come out of the soil.
By then, I'll be gone.
I nudge it with my mouthparts.
Too heavy to lift.

lines.zh: 我用前足把骨头拨出巢口。
lines.en: I shovel a bone out of the nest with my foreleg.

lines.zh: 这块石头压住了我的产卵口。
lines.en: This stone is blocking my egg-laying hole.

lines.zh: 地上这些东西，我不需要。
lines.en: I've no need for what's on the ground.
I bite. Too hard to break.
Yours. I stay off it.

lines.zh: 我把卵推进沙里，仔细埋好。
lines.en: I push the eggs into the sand and bury them well.
Buried in the sand. Cleaner that way.
So no one comes poking for it.

lines.zh: 沙面传来震动，我抬起了头。
lines.en: A tremor runs through the sand; I raise my head.

lines.zh: 锁定你了，尾管已经烧红。
lines.en: Locked on you, and my tail vent is glowing red.
Heat builds in my throat.

lines.zh: 我掠过干地，沙面被我推出一道脊。
lines.en: I skim the dry ground, raising a ridge of sand.
I open my mouth. It's bright inside.
It's bright inside.
Don't bother dodging. You can't.
This is open ground.
Open ground. Nothing to hide behind.
I raise my front half.
One last second.
The fire is in my throat.

lines.zh: 我飞得很低，影子扫过沙丘。
lines.en: I fly low, my shadow sweeping the dunes.
You're running faster than before.
Running changes nothing.
My fire carries a long way.

lines.zh: 我悬在半空，盯着你的脖子。
lines.en: I hover and fix on your neck.
The heat in my throat is steady.
You go left. I turn slowly.
I need no speed, only aim.
Only a good aim.

lines.zh: 尾爆兽的翅膀一展，火就来了。
lines.en: My tail-blaster wings spread, and the fire follows.
Don't run in a straight line.
You ran in a straight line.
I let out a stream of fire.
The sand bakes into a hard crust.
That one spread wide.
I raise my head and spray again.
The fire lands and keeps burning.
You try to get around. Too close.

lines.zh: 我俯冲下来，头壳顶向你。
lines.en: I dive, driving my head plate at you.
That impact is more solid than fire.
You retreat. I add one more.
That burst of flame is enough.
A mound rises in the sand.

lines.zh: 我顶开沙壳，抖落一身土。
lines.en: I push off the sand crust and shake off the dirt.
The head comes first.
Then the wings, shaking off sand.

lines.zh: 我在这一片地下，长到头了。
lines.en: I've grown as far as I go, under this ground.
Now it's the surface's turn.
This ground will change.
Not by my doing.
It's what's in the soil.

lines.zh: 我绕了一圈，看看有没有人。
lines.en: I circle once to check for anyone.

lines.zh: 火对我没用，我肚子里就是火。
lines.en: Fire's no use on me. I carry it inside.

lines.zh: 我从空中掉下来，砸出一个坑。
lines.en: I fell and left a crater.
Once soaked, my wings turn heavy.

lines.zh: 震得我翻了身，沙全扬起来。
lines.en: The blast flipped me and threw up the sand.
Something's wedged in my shell seam.
The light put out my fire.
An empty belly makes weaker fire.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，沙子成了玻璃。
lines.en: Lightning struck and the sand turned to glass.
No sand here, and no soil.
